lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in approximately eight discernible vertical columns along the lateral flank. Each column contains 3 to 6 primary nodes of elevated pixel intensity. Spacing between centroids is relatively uniform in the mid-section, becoming more compressed toward the anterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with the circular blobs, forming a primary grid structure where the blobs act as high-intensity nodes within the vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a clear luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal aspect and lower pixel values creating a shadow on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive U-shaped or looped configuration is visible in the vertical stripe pattern located in the mid-anterior region of the lateral flank.
